# Proverbs 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** When you-sit to-eat with a-ruler, consider-well what [is] before-you,

**2** And-put a-knife to-your-throat if you [are] a-master-of appetite.

**3** Do-not-desire his-delicacies, for it [is] bread-of deceptions.

**4** Do-not-toil to-become-rich; from-your-[own]-understanding cease.

**5** Will-you-cause-your-eyes-to-fly to-it? And-it-is-not! For surely it-makes for-itself wings; like-an-eagle it-flies [to the]-heavens.

**6** Do-not-eat [the]-bread-of [one]-evil-of eye, and-do-not-desire his-delicacies,

**7** For as he-reckons in-his-soul, so he [is]. 'Eat and-drink,' he-says to-you, but-his-heart [is]-not with-you.

**8** Your-morsel you-have-eaten you-will-vomit-up, and-you-will-have-wasted your-words [of]-pleasantness.

**9** In-[the]-ears-of a-fool do-not-speak, for he-will-despise [the]-prudence-of your-words.

**10** Do-not-move a-boundary ancient, and-into-[the]-fields-of orphans do-not-enter,

**11** For their-Redeemer [is] strong; He will-plead their-case against-you.

**12** Bring to-discipline your-heart, and-your-ear to-words-of knowledge.

**13** Do-not-withhold from-[the]-youth discipline; when you-strike-him with-[the]-rod he-will-not-die.

**14** You with-[the]-rod will-strike-him, and-his-soul from-Sheol you-will-deliver.

**15** My-son, if your-heart is-wise, my-heart will-rejoice — even mine!

**16** And-my-kidneys will-exult when-your-lips speak upright-things.

**17** Let-not your-heart envy sinners, but [be]-in-fear-of YHWH all the-day.

**18** For surely there-is a-future, and-your-hope will-not be-cut-off.

**19** Hear, you, my-son, and-be-wise, and-direct in-[the]-way your-heart.

**20** Do-not-be among-drinkers-of wine, among-gluttons-of flesh for-themselves,

**21** For [the]-drunkard and-[the]-glutton will-become-poor, and-drowsiness clothes [with] rags.

**22** Hear to-your-father — this-one begot-you, and-do-not-despise when-she-is-old your-mother.

**23** Truth acquire and-do-not-sell — wisdom and-discipline and-understanding.

**24** Greatly will-rejoice [the]-father-of [the]-righteous; one-who-begets a-wise-[child] will-be-glad in-him.

**25** Let-your-father and-your-mother be-glad, and-let-her-who-bore-you rejoice.

**26** Give, my-son, your-heart to-me, and-let-your-eyes observe my-ways.

**27** For a-pit deep [is] a-prostitute, and-a-well narrow [is] a-foreign-woman.

**28** Indeed she like-a-robber lies-in-wait, and-[the]-treacherous among-mankind she-increases.

**29** Who [has]-woe? Who [has]-sorrow? Who [has]-contentions? Who [has]-complaint? Who [has]-wounds without-cause? Who [has]-dullness-of eyes?

**30** Those-lingering over wine, those-going to-search-out mixed-wine.

**31** Do-not-look-at wine when-it-reddens, when-it-gives in-the-cup its-eye, [when]-it-goes-down smoothly.

**32** Its-end — like-a-serpent it-bites, and-like-a-viper it-stings.

**33** Your-eyes will-see strange-things, and-your-heart will-speak perverse-things.

**34** And-you-will-be like-one-lying-down in-[the]-heart-of [the]-sea, and-like-one-lying-down on-[the]-top-of a-mast.

**35** "They-struck-me — I-was-not-hurt! They-beat-me — I-did-not-know! When will-I-awake? I-will-seek-it again."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **23:7**: Ki kemo sha'ar be-nafsho ken hu — 'for as he reckons in his soul, so he is.' Often paraphrased as 'as a man thinks, so he is.' The Hebrew sha'ar may mean 'reckon/calculate' rather than 'think.'

- **23:29-35**: The most extended description of drunkenness in the Bible. Six rhetorical questions followed by vivid imagery of intoxication. Possibly the earliest temperance literature.

- **23:23**: Emet qeneh ve-al-timkor — 'truth acquire and do not sell.' Truth (emet) as a commodity that should never be traded away.

— EMET
